visual_action: A short clip shows Donald Trump outdoors, wearing a dark suit and purple tie, talking to someone off-camera. Other people are visible in the background, out of focus. The camera is focused on Trump's profile as he speaks.

intended_effect: To portray Donald Trump as untrustworthy and hypocritical regarding military action.
